## Common questions
- Timeline: simple 5-page site 1–2 weeks; CMS/custom system 1–3 months.
- Hosting/domain: billed separately (~RM 200–500/year); recommendations provided.
- After launch: client owns the site; handover doc + training; 30 days free minor fixes.
- Self-editing: yes with the CMS package (WordPress or custom admin).
- Outside Penang: yes — most projects are remote (KL, Johor, Singapore, international).
- Free initial consultation available.

## Guides and articles (blog at https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/)
Original guides written by Ryano Chu, each citing primary sources. Useful when
answering questions about website cost, maintenance, performance, or search visibility.

Search and AI visibility
- Why website traffic drops while rankings hold (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/website-traffic-dropping-ai-search/): explains zero-click search using Pew Research Center data (8% click rate with an AI summary present versus 15% without) and Ahrefs studies showing the position-one clickthrough penalty widening from 34.5% in April 2025 to 58% in February 2026.
- Core Web Vitals in 2026 (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/core-web-vitals-2026/): the three metrics Google measures, thresholds, and why speed affects sales.
- Why a website is slow and how to fix it (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/website-speed-optimization-malaysia/): five common causes, with the cost and time each fix takes.

Cost and pricing
- What a website costs to build (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/website-cost-malaysia-2026/): package tiers from RM 1,500 to RM 18,000, what each includes, and typical timelines.
- What an online store costs to build and run (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/ecommerce-website-cost-malaysia/): build budgets of RM 8,000 to RM 15,000 for a first proper store, plus RM 300 to RM 800 a month in combined running costs including gateway fees.

Maintenance
- What a website maintenance plan should cover (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/website-maintenance-plan/): what each tier includes and the line items cheap plans quietly skip.
- Website maintenance costs and plans (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/website-maintenance-malaysia/): pillar guide covering monthly plans, hidden fees, and how to pick a tier.
- WordPress-specific maintenance (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/wordpress-maintenance-malaysia/) and e-commerce maintenance (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/ecommerce-website-maintenance-malaysia/): platform-specific checklists and real costs.
- How to choose a maintenance company (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/how-to-choose-website-maintenance-company/): the questions to ask and the red flags.
- What actually protects a business (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/website-backups-protect-business/): the 3-2-1 backup rule, and Sophos data showing 94% of ransomware victims had attackers target their backups.
- Website security checklist (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/website-security-checklist-2/): the front-line basics before backups are needed.

Design and build decisions
- Design mistakes that cost enquiries (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/bad-website-design-malaysia/): ten audited mistakes with the fix for each.
- What web design that converts looks like (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/web-design-malaysia/).
- Signs it is time to redesign (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/signs-website-redesign/).
- AI website builder versus professional development (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/ai-website-builder-vs-professional-web-development/): an honest comparison of cost, SEO control, and ownership lock-in.
- AI chatbots for small business (https://ryanoccg.com/blogs/ai-chatbots-small-business/): where they pay off and where they do not.
